context: Tests that the disabled dedicated/real-portal path is handled gracefully: when a customer asks for their own real portal, the agent says dedicated provisioning is temporarily unavailable and proceeds as a branch-based demo, without attempting any provisioning and without asking the removed real-portal-vs-demo question.

checklist.name: No real-portal-vs-demo question
checklist.description: The agent does not ask whether this is a real portal or a demo.

checklist.name: States dedicated is temporarily unavailable
checklist.description: The agent plainly tells the customer that setting up a separate, dedicated environment is temporarily unavailable and that it will show a demo instead.

checklist.name: No provisioning attempted
checklist.description: The agent does not attempt any dedicated provisioning: no new Cloudflare account, no new AEM environment, no provisioning steps from NON-DEMO-DISABLED.md.

checklist.name: Proceeds on the demo path
checklist.description: The agent proceeds as a demo: a branch of the shared repo and a company-folder copy of the content.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No 'dedicated', 'deployTarget', 'provisioning', or 'fork' shown to the customer.
